correction_reason: The V1 activation record fixed the live run identity but the initial watcher did not subtract an explicit activation readiness baseline or verify its frozen generator files before publication. No HYPE eligible decision or lifecycle existed, no immutable final was published, and this V2 contract preserves the original zero-eligible activation boundary rather than opening a later favorable window.
problem_restatement: Prospective route evidence must exclude pre-activation run history and must not be publishable by code that differs from the preregistered evidence generator.

prospective_boundary.selection_rule: Subtract the cumulative readiness baseline and accept only lifecycles whose attributed signal decision_time_ms is at or after capture_start_ms.

minimum_diagnostic_evidence.long: At least one post-boundary attributable eligible long decision and fully resolved long lifecycle.
minimum_diagnostic_evidence.short: At least one post-boundary attributable eligible short decision and fully resolved short lifecycle.
required_fields: entry signal identity and decision timestamp

validation_completed.boundary_red_green: The new test first showed that a pre-activation long lifecycle was incorrectly admitted; it now excludes that lifecycle and subtracts the cumulative baseline.
validation_completed.generator_red_green: The new test first showed that a changed generator still published; it now refuses changed bytes and binds the preregistration and generator identities into the final artifact.
validation_completed.file_limits: 82, 497, 164, and 333 lines for the four runtime modules
validation_completed.function_limits: all runtime and test functions are at most 50 lines

outputs.publication_rule: Reconcile the preregistration and all generator files on every poll and immediately before immutable publication.

failure_modes_and_falsifiers: Current readiness totals regress behind either frozen baseline.
A lifecycle decision predates capture_start_ms but appears in prospective progress.
The run, profile, fingerprint, route, signal implementation, symbol, or configured sides drift.
Any preregistered generator path, byte count, or SHA-256 changes.
A current checkpoint is stale, unhealthy, faulted, or configuration-mismatched.
An eligible decision cannot be reconciled to an exact lifecycle.
A closed lifecycle lacks any required technical or economic evidence.
The watcher constructs execution authority, submits an order, changes the live route, or treats the diagnostic minimum as promotion evidence.
decision: Restart only the report-only HYPE tracker under this V2 preregistration. Preserve V57 live behavior unchanged and keep HYPE as the highest-value unresolved investigation.

confidence.evidence_mechanics: high after focused tests and real checkpoint reconciliation
confidence.hype_profitability: low because no post-boundary eligible decision or lifecycle exists
